categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in three segments: display materials, pharmaceutical CDMO (Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization), and electronic materials. The display materials segment includes OLED sublimation materials and liquid crystal monomers used in various display panels. The pharmaceutical segment focuses on innovative drug intermediates and raw materials, while the electronic materials segment covers semiconductor photoresist monomers and related products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include organic compound synthesis design, hydrogen isotope substitution reactions, novel catalytic coupling reactions, high-efficiency isomerization, precise hydrogenation, enzyme-catalyzed stereoselective synthesis, microchannel continuous flow reactions, advanced chromatographic separation, halogen impurity control, chiral isomer impurity control, metal ion control, trace impurity analysis, and isotope analysis. The company has established a comprehensive industrial production system emphasizing process optimization, precise control, and scale-up capabilities.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are major global and domestic display panel manufacturers and pharmaceutical companies, especially in Japan, Europe, and Korea. The end markets include consumer electronics such as TVs, smartphones, computers, automotive displays, and medical drug manufacturers. The company maintains strategic partnerships with leading firms like Merck, JNC, Dupont, and Roche's subsidiary Chugai.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with subsidiaries in Shaanxi Province and a wholly-owned subsidiary in Japan. Overseas sales account for a significant portion of revenue, with major export markets in Japan, Europe, and South Korea. Domestic operations are concentrated in Xi'an and surrounding regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily upstream and midstream in the supply chain, focusing on the research, development, and production of specialized organic new materials supplied to downstream display panel manufacturers and pharmaceutical companies. It acts as a strategic supplier providing customized materials and intermediates.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include maintaining leadership in OLED sublimation materials, expanding domestic market share, advancing pharmaceutical raw material production, and achieving breakthroughs in electronic materials. The company emphasizes technology innovation, AI integration in R&D, process optimization, and expanding product pipelines in amino acids, peptides, and semiconductor resins. It also pursues ESG initiatives and operational efficiency improvements.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through the production and direct sales of customized specialized organic new materials to downstream customers. The company follows a direct sales model with some sales via designated agents in Japan and South Korea. Revenue is recognized upon transfer of control of goods to customers, typically at delivery or upon receipt of shipping documents.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player in OLED sublimation materials and liquid crystal monomers with advanced global-level technology. It holds a strong market position with high customer stickiness and strategic supplier status. In pharmaceutical CDMO, it is a later entrant facing intense competition but leverages its chemical synthesis expertise. In electronic materials, it is growing but still behind leading domestic and international competitors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 1.46 billion, a 20.74% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 251.7 million, an 87.6% increase. R&D investment was RMB 121 million, about 8.3% of revenue. The company has total assets of RMB 3.4 billion and equity of RMB 3.0 billion, showing steady growth and improving profitability driven by cost control and product mix optimization.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, customized organic new materials with advanced synthesis and purification technologies ensuring superior product purity and stability. It offers rapid response to customer technical requirements, strong R&D capabilities, and a comprehensive industrialization system. Its early mover advantage in deuterated OLED materials and close collaboration with global leading customers create high entry barriers and competitive differentiation.
